sources.title: Gemini API release notes
sources.evidence: The June 17, 2025 entry explicitly releases gemini-2.5-flash-lite-preview-06-17. July 22 releases the separate stable ID. The November 4 entry announces shutdown of the exact June preview endpoint on November 18, 2025.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5: Updates to our family of thinking models (June 17, 2025)
sources.evidence: Reopened on October 27, 2026. The June 17 release introduces the new Flash-Lite preview, optional thinking, multimodal inputs and tools. It publishes no nominal total or active parameter count and does not identify an unchanged named base with a published size.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite is now stable and generally available (July 22, 2025)
sources.evidence: Reopened on October 27, 2026. Google explicitly states that the July stable ID uses the same underlying model as the preview; this supports transferring any applicable nominal model-size disclosure between those two IDs. The post publishes no size. Its initial August removal plan predates the later November 18 shutdown notice.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite Model Card (September 26, 2025)
sources.evidence: Reopened and searched in full on October 27, 2026. The September 26 card describes sparse MoE routing and separately labels June 06-17 thinking/non-thinking and September 09-2025 evaluation columns. It gives no total or per-token active count, expert count, routing count or dimensions from which one can be established.

sources.title: Gemini models — historical indexed exact June preview specification
sources.evidence: Search-indexed historical page identifies models/gemini-2.5-flash-lite-preview-06-17 and explicitly lists 1,000,000 input tokens, 64,000 output tokens, text/image/video/audio inputs, text output, thinking and function calling. The live URL now redirects to the current model index, so this is historical indexed documentation, not current availability evidence.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite — Gemini API
sources.evidence: The stable ID specification lists 1,048,576 input tokens, 65,536 output tokens, text/image/video/audio/PDF input, text output, thinking and function calling. Same-underlying-model identity is independently established by the July GA announcement; the current page does not list the June preview endpoint.

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Hosted model access is subject to proprietary API terms, including a prohibition on extracting underlying model parameter weights. The current terms are effective March 23, 2026; this is a descriptive proprietary classification, not an assertion that these exact terms applied unchanged in June 2025.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5 technical report
sources.evidence: Reopened and searched in full on October 27, 2026. The 73-page report explicitly discusses gemini-2.5-flash-lite-preview-06-17 on pages 9-10, while its main comparison table covers Pro/Flash and 2.0 Flash-Lite. The exact-preview section and generic sparse-MoE description supply no nominal total or active count. The 22-billion and trillion-parameter references describe cited ViT/Switch research, not this model.

sources.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Model Card (March 2026)
sources.evidence: Freshly retrieved and checked October 27, 2026. Its comparison table includes Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite Dynamic, reporting benchmark scores, price and throughput but no total or active parameter column. Its stated Gemini 3 Pro basis is for Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, not evidence about the June 2025 preview.

sources.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite Model Card (July 2026)
sources.evidence: Freshly retrieved and checked October 27, 2026. The later card identifies Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite as the basis for Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite; it supplies no retrospective total or active count for the June 2025 model. This later-generation relationship does not establish the older model size.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon Model Card (October 2026)
sources.evidence: Freshly retrieved and checked October 27, 2026. The October Argon card supplies no retrospective nominal total or active count for Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite.

sources.title: Models.dev exact June preview record
sources.evidence: Catalog source inspected as a lead. It explicitly copies modalities and limits from the GA model and provides no independent parameter or architecture evidence.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5 Flash and Flash-Lite September preview release
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The September 25 announcement names gemini-2.5-flash-lite-preview-09-2025 as a separately trained and updated preview, while directing stable users to keep gemini-2.5-flash-lite. It gives no parameter count; its reduced output-token usage is not a parameter reduction or size disclosure.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Safety Report
sources.evidence: Freshly retrieved and searched October 27, 2026 for retrospective size disclosures. No Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite total or active parameter specification appears. Parameter mentions concern an evaluation difficulty parameter, weight security and encoded knowledge, not a model-size table.

name.note: Preserves the exact June dated preview identity; not the later stable or September preview identifier.

developer.note: Published by Google and developed by Google DeepMind; retain the catalog developer normalization.

family.note: Normalized Flash-Lite subfamily within Gemini 2.5, explicitly identified by Google.

release_date.note: First public availability of the exact dated preview, explicitly recorded in the release notes; July 22 is stable-ID availability.

open_weights.note: Released through proprietary Google-hosted interfaces. No downloadable checkpoint or open-weight grant is offered in the reviewed release/model materials.

license.note: Descriptive model/service license classification; documentation copyright licenses do not license model weights.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 exact-ID, nominal-size and lineage searches found no developer-published total count. The July GA announcement explicitly establishes the same underlying model as the June preview, so a supported GA nominal size would apply; none was found in the reopened launch/card/report or later primary comparisons. September preview and later Flash-Lite generations remain distinct. This null reflects absent numeric evidence, not a requirement for an exact tensor census.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 searches separately checked active/activated counts and later primary comparison tables. Sparse MoE routing is documented, but no nominal per-token active count or sufficient expert/routing dimensions were found for the June preview or identical July GA model. Thinking budgets, output-token efficiency, benchmark scores and later-model lineage do not determine this count.

architecture.note: Exact FlashLite card states sparse MoE Transformer and separately labels the June06-17 and September preview evaluation columns. July22 announcement also explicitly equates June preview and stable model.

context_window.note: Use the 1,000,000 input-token limit directly printed for the exact June preview in historical indexed primary documentation. Current stable-ID docs say 1,048,576; the underlying model is shared, but identical endpoint limits or rounding are not separately established. This records documented precision, not a proven 48,576-token functional difference.

modalities.note: Exact-preview documentation confirms text/image/audio/video inputs and text output. PDF is explicitly supported by the stable model that Google identifies as the same underlying model; PDF is a supported document input format, not an additional output modality.

reasoning.note: Exact-preview launch and specification document configurable thinking; support is not a claim that thinking is always enabled.

tool_call.note: Exact-preview capability table explicitly lists function calling as supported; launch also describes native tools.

description.value: June 2025 preview of Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite with optional thinking and function calling.

patch.notes: June 17, 2025 preview; Google identifies the July stable release as the same underlying model. Sparse MoE Transformer; neither total nor active parameter count is published in the reviewed sources. The September preview is a separate update. Historical exact-preview docs list 1,000,000 input tokens; stable-ID docs list 1,048,576. The November 4 notice scheduled this endpoint for shutdown on November 18, superseding an earlier August removal plan.
patch.description: June 2025 preview of Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite with optional thinking and function calling.

summary: Fresh parameter-only re-audit on October 27, 2026: retain explicit null total and active counts after independent exact-ID, nominal-size, activation and lineage searches, reopening the June/July releases, Flash-Lite card and Gemini 2.5 technical report, and checking later first-party Flash-Lite/Argon cards and the Gemini 4 safety report. Google explicitly equates the June preview and July GA underlying model, a valid basis for nominal-size transfer, but no applicable numeric count was found. Keep September and later-generation previews distinct. Preserve the original other 12 field assessments and their patches.
